author: Engineezy
description:
Trying to turn an Etch A Sketch into a Customizable Smart Display.
•••This started with a pretty simple question: can I make an Etch A Sketch draw any image I want? I 3D printed pulleys, added belts and stepper motors, and used @ChatGPT to help me build the app and code to convert images into continuous etch-a-sketchable line drawings. Next I need to make it erase itself and add some smart features. Stay Tuned!
